question: Name the dance of Rajasthan which uses a fake horse ride as a prop.
solution: The correct answer is __**Kacchi Ghodi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Kacchi Ghodi • ​Kachhi Ghodi dance is a folk dance that originated from the Shekhawati region of Rajasthan state. • It is a dance performed on the wooden dummy horses. • It is performed by Potters, Kamdholi, Sarghara, Bhambi, and Bavi communities.​
